item.title: The Astonishing Story Of The North Dakota Blizzard Of 1966 That Ravaged The State
item.description: The brutal blizzard of 1966 hit many U.S. states, but North Dakota was arguably struck the hardest — with wind gusts exceeding 70 miles per hour, snowfall totaling over 30 inches, and severely limited visibility that remained near-zero for about 30 hours.
